name: Essential Cart Drawer
summary: Shopify slide-out cart drawer with in-cart upsells, a free-shipping reward bar, countdown timer, announcement bar and sticky add-to-cart bar; every plan has every feature, with plans tiered by monthly drawer orders.
best_for: Shopify stores that want a slide-out cart with upsells, a free-shipping goal and a sticky add-to-cart bar in one app, and prefer a bill that follows how many orders go through the drawer
skip_if: you want a different cart on every plan tier, you sell mostly through express checkouts that skip the drawer, you want a tool we have tested ourselves, or your theme already has a cart you like
honest_knock: The price follows drawer orders, so a store that sells well through the cart moves up the ladder, and eight paid steps make the bill harder to predict than one flat fee. Express checkouts that skip the drawer are not counted, so check how many of your orders use it. We have not installed the app, so theme fit and speed are unknown to us.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Essential 1 · per month for up to 99 drawer orders
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-16 on essential-apps.com/cart-drawer/pricing, US dollars a month billed through Shopify) Nine plans with the same features, metered on orders that go through the cart drawer in a rolling 30 days. Free is $0 for up to 30 orders. Essential 1 is $8.99 for up to 99, Essential 2 $13.99 for up to 199, Essential 3 $23.99 for up to 499, Essential 4 $38.99 for up to 999, Essential 5 $58.99 for up to 1,999, Essential 6 $88.99 for up to 4,999, Essential 7 $138.99 for up to 9,999 and Unlimited $198.99 for 10,000 or more. The first paid plan has a 14-day free trial, once per store. Passing a limit moves you to the next plan automatically. We have not paid for a plan.
